terms.gloss: a spear, a lance; set up at a public sale, hence sub hastā, at auction
evidence: Cic. Sen. 19: nec ēminus hastīs aut comminus gladiīs ūterētur (Lewis & Short)
Liv. 23.38.7: comitibus eōrum sub hastā vēnditīs (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: nec ēminus hastīs aut comminus gladiīs ūterētur
phrases.english: nor would he use spears at long range or swords at close quarters
their companions having been sold at auction

sources: Lewis & Short: hasta
